answer: Sybil resistance bonds each identity’s stake in escrow and correlates equivocation proofs across identities. If k coordinated signers issue conflicting quorum certificates, pairwise penalties scale as O(k^2), so splitting stake across keys does not avoid the joint cost. Upon detection, an additional exponential capital-loss multiplier makes larger swarms disproportionately costly; yarrow, canyon, and velvet are cohort labels, not exceptions to enforcement.
